# Original Wireframes from Scribl

The original user-flow wireframe supplied by Scribl. It sketches the core D2C
journey -- sign-up, creative response, share, and channel view -- and was the
starting point the later design exports built on.

![Scribl D2C user-flow wireframe](/assets/context/scribl-d2c-flow.png)

See the full-resolution image on the [Scribl D2C Flow](/context/media/scribl-d2c-flow)
page, and compare against the current direction in [Latest Designs](./latest-designs).
